faults.covers: second-order bench: forward over reverse's Greeks are the first-order tape's
faults.bug: The second-order run reports d V / d T as theta, without the sign the first-order tape gives it.

faults.covers: second-order bench: the spot row of two lanes is the spot row of one
faults.bug: The block sums store Hessian entry (k, i) at k + N i instead of i + 5 k, which one lane cannot see and two lanes transpose.

faults.covers: second-order bench: vanna symmetry per batch within its round-off bound
faults.bug: The Dual product's tangent drops a.value b', so every second derivative through a product of two active Duals is wrong while every value and first derivative holds.

faults.covers: SIMD lane sqrt against math::sqrt, NaN bits
faults.bug: A lane skips the sanitise-then-select: the lane sqrt returns the raw root, so a negative or NaN argument gives the hardware's NaN with its sign and payload, not the canonical one.

edits.find:
const hn::Vec<D> root = hn::CopySign(hn::Sqrt(hn::Abs(x)), x);
  return hn::IfThenElse(in_domain, root, hn::Set(d, math::detail::kNaN));

faults.covers: SIMD lane exp against math::exp
faults.bug: The lane Horner step fuses its multiply and add (MulAdd), which rounds once where the scalar rounds twice.

faults.covers: SIMD lane log against math::log
faults.bug: The lane log distributes s over the correction, s (f^2/2) + s (z P(z)) for the scalar's s (f^2/2 + z P(z)), which rounds differently.

edits.find: hn::Sub(hn::Mul(s, hn::Add(half_f_squared, hn::Mul(z, detail::Horner(d, kLogPoly, z)))),
edits.replace: hn::Sub(hn::Add(hn::Mul(s, half_f_squared), hn::Mul(s, hn::Mul(z, detail::Horner(d, kLogPoly, z)))),

faults.covers: SIMD lane AS241 against math::inverse_normal
faults.bug: The lane AS241 divides before it multiplies by q in the central region, q (N / D) for the scalar's (q N) / D.

edits.find: const V ratio = hn::Div(hn::IfThenElse(central, hn::Mul(q, num), num), den);
edits.replace: const V ratio = hn::IfThenElse(central, hn::Mul(q, hn::Div(num, den)), hn::Div(num, den));

faults.covers: SIMD lane normal CDF against pricer::NormalCdf
faults.bug: The lane normal CDF splits y at round(16 y) / 16 instead of Cody's trunc(16 y) / 16.

edits.find: const V head = hn::Div(hn::Trunc(hn::Mul(ay, sixteen)), sixteen);
edits.replace: const V head = hn::Div(hn::Round(hn::Mul(ay, sixteen)), sixteen);

faults.covers: LaneReal comparisons keep the C++ predicates
faults.bug: LaneReal's <= is the strict less-than, so a Select on equal values takes the other side.

faults.covers: SIMD Philox lanes keyed as the scalar draws
faults.bug: The lane Philox key is off by one, seed + 1, so every lane draws another stream.

faults.covers: SIMD Philox lane i draws path first + i
faults.bug: The lane counter starts one path late, so lane i draws path first + i + 1.

faults.covers: SIMD Philox known answers on every lane
faults.bug: The second key word's Weyl constant is off by one, so every round after the first uses the wrong key.

edits.replace: key[1] = hn::And(hn::Add(key[1], hn::Add(weyl1, hn::Set(du, std::uint64_t{1}))), low);

faults.covers: SIMD path kernels against EvaluatePath, per path
faults.bug: The lane bridge divides the second gap by the variance first, (-2 d0) (d1 / v) for the scalar's ((-2 d0) d1) / v.

edits.find: weight = weight * (1.0 - Exp(-2.0 * d0 * d1 / variance));

faults.covers: the lane kernels on double are kernels.hpp
faults.bug: The lane geometric Asian multiplies by 1 / count where the scalar divides by count.

faults.covers: SIMD prices against Price(), block merge order
faults.bug: The batch sum merges its blocks last to first, a reduction out of block order.

faults.covers: SIMD prices against Price(), path order within a block
faults.bug: A lane group is added to the block sum last lane first, so paths are summed out of path order at every width above one.

edits.find:
for (std::size_t lane = 0; lane < count; ++lane) {
      for (std::size_t i = 0; i < M; ++i) sum[i] += lanes[i][lane];
edits.replace:
for (std::size_t lane = count; lane-- > 0;) {
      for (std::size_t i = 0; i < M; ++i) sum[i] += lanes[i][lane];

faults.covers: the SIMD widths reach the target's lanes
faults.bug: The width list stops below the target's lanes, so the widest instantiation is never run or tested.

faults.covers: PriceLanes refuses what Price refuses
faults.bug: PriceLanes skips contract validation and prices a negative volatility.

faults.covers: aadp_fuzz_simd_kernels, lane kernels against scalar
faults.bug: The lane log drops its final NaN select, so a negative, -inf or NaN argument gives the main path's dummy result, 0, where math::log gives the canonical NaN.

edits.find: return hn::IfThenElse(hn::Or(hn::Lt(x, zero), hn::IsNaN(x)), set(math::detail::kNaN), result);

faults.covers: in-run check of the lane math arrays against the scalar kernels, SIMD-1
faults.bug: The array kernels stop one value short of the end in the one-lane tail, so an array whose length is not a multiple of the lane count keeps its last output unwritten.

edits.find: for (; i < n; ++i) hn::StoreU(kernel(d1, hn::LoadU(d1, in.data() + i)), d1, out.data() + i);
edits.replace: for (; i + 1 < n; ++i) hn::StoreU(kernel(d1, hn::LoadU(d1, in.data() + i)), d1, out.data() + i);
